verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents case management where analysts review alerts and select a case decision ('no risk detected', 'risk detected - accepted', 'risk detected - offboard'). An API returns the audit log trail for a case, which gives a recorded investigation history of decisions. However, nothing in the pack shows analysts can attach evidence, write free-text notes, or record decision reasons in that history. Missing for 10: documented note/comment capture, evidence/file attachment on cases, free-text decision rationale fields, hands-on corroboration.
